verdict.rationale: Community reports show a paid Gemini model API in use, with per-token pricing and limited sampling parameters via AI Studio. However, the runtime probe found that the Gemini consumer app exposes no API or agent-discovery surface, and that the developer API on ai.google.dev is a separate product. None of the first-party docs in the pack describe programmatic access to app features such as Gems, notebooks, scheduled actions or Connected Apps. Missing for 10: first-party API documentation in the evidence, API coverage of the app's own features, and hands-on evidence of driving the app programmatically.
